mechanism: Carbamazepine is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce penicillin VK levels, though penicillin VK is primarily renally eliminated; conversely, penicillin VK may inhibit carbamazepine metabolism leading to increased carbamazepine levels.
action: Monitor for reduced penicillin efficacy and carbamazepine toxicity signs (dizziness, ataxia, diplopia); consider alternative antibiotic or carbamazepine level monitoring if combination is necessary.
